review: All 102 images visually reviewed. Six About, SFTP-settings and Updates images were recaptured in RU/EN from committed 0.5.2 source. The other 96 images retain their original 0.5.0 PNG checksums and exact source/generator commits; their demonstrated UI is unchanged. Every image records sourceVersion; visibleAppVersion is present only when the app version is printed in that image.
knownLimitations: These are Flutter widget-test renderings with synthetic services, terminal output, local model states and 16 GiB AI hardware recommendation; no native shell, WSL distribution or model inference is started by captures.
Windows widget variants run on a macOS test host with system font aliases; these images do not establish native Windows or WSL compatibility.

Widget tests do not render a native OS keyboard; keyboard screenshots show the reserved 200 logical pixel bottom inset. Mobile RDP captures show Android widgets; matching iOS layout tests run separately.

The 0.5-series guide combines 96 unchanged source-0.5.0 captures with six source-0.5.2 captures. These are widget renderings from recorded commits, not installed CI release packages. Source versions are 0.5.0+18016 and 0.5.2+20016; visible version labels now show 0.5.2+20016. Package build numbers and native smoke results are verified separately.
Pickers are scrollable; a partially visible next SSH row at the bottom of the WSL picker is the normal viewport boundary.
